Sofia (CS): quick FYI — Arcadia is planning to add personalization to 3 additional product squads in July and wants a pilot for realtime session summarization + per-session embeddings. could be a launch spike.

Noah (Arcadia - PM): correct. phased rollout mid-July. baseline ~30 RPS, launch bursts up to ~200 RPS for 10-20m. summaries ~500-700 tokens; embeds ~50 tokens. aiming for 95p latency <450ms.

Rahul (CS Ops): thanks — do we have concurrency per squad and expected daily active sessions? also any PII/compliance flags?

Noah (Arcadia - PM): per-squad concurrency ~15-25; launch hour could add ~4-6k active sessions. user messages may include PII; they require KMS + audit logs and SSO.

Marta (Solutions Eng): pilot suggestion: hosted for steady-state, small pre-warmed dedicated pool for bursts, prefix/KV caching for summaries, separate routes for heavy vs light calls, canary 10% then ramp with fallback to hosted. sample canary snippet: {"route":"/summaries","canary_pct":10,"dedicated_threshold_rps":120,"fallback":"/summaries-hosted"}

Ethan (AE): I'll prepare a commercial brief (cost delta + reserved options) once Marta shares topology.

Sofia (CS): action items:
- Noah: sanitized payloads + squad launch dates (by Tue)
- Marta: pilot topology + KMS steps + cost first-pass (by Wed)
- Rahul: schedule 45-min prep workshop with SE/infra (by Mon)
- Ethan: draft pricing note for Arcadia execs (by Thu)

prep-bot: task created: "Arcadia pilot: collect payloads + security classification" :white_check_mark:

Sofia (CS): marking this as an expansion lead and renewal-watch until pilot completes. will update CRM and account health doc.
